title: OGLO Session Report Suite Generator (Completed Phase 1)
description: Generate a standardized folder structure for each NWB session containing report-suite.ipynb (interactive report), report-suite.html (fully compiled HTML export), and figures/svg/ (vector exports of all generated figures).

title: OGLO Report Suite Improvement (Phase 2)
description: Expand and compile the report suite to include exactly 10 comprehensive analyses with correct, visually valid SVG exports using the Madelane Golden Dark palette. Ensure precise coordinates, axis formatting, legends, and labels for all figures.

title: SVM Preprocessing (Baseline Subtraction & Normalization)
description: Expose baseline-subtraction parameters to normalize trial spike count vectors (e.g. subtracting pre-stimulus interval baseline firing rates) before training the SVM classifier to control for state fluctuations.

title: Interactive Granger Causality Network Visualization
description: Develop an interactive directed graph visualization using Plotly in `jnwb/viz.py` that maps inter-area Granger causality causality flow as edge thickness, permitting dynamic node dragging and hover inspections.

title: GPU-Accelerated Population Trajectory (PCA)
description: Utilize PyTorch or JAX Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on GPU to accelerate population trajectory dimensionality reduction (PCA) across thousands of active neurons.

title: Reconcile Stable/S+/S-/O+ Definitions for V182o Re-Audit
description: The live jnwb.addressing is_stable proxy (quality>=1.0, stable_plus aliased identically) is a much weaker test than the project's canonical 3-criterion stability pipeline (tag_stable_units.py: >=5 spikes/trial in every correct trial + firing_rate>=1Hz + (presence_ratio>=0.98 OR snr>0.75)), and the earlier V182o O+ candidate audit (examples/06_find_omission_positive_units_v182o.py) used an ad hoc Mann-Whitney+4Hz-diff test instead of the project's real candidate-labeling pipeline (run_spk_response_metrics_a8_1.py: paired Wilcoxon vs local pre-omission baseline + unpaired Mann-Whitney vs matched control, Cohen's d>0.3, BH-FDR q<0.05, S_plus/S_minus/O_plus_candidate/X_candidate priority resolution). Re-run both the canonical stability test and the canonical S+/S-/O+/X candidate pipeline on sub-V182o_ses-260629 so results are comparable to the historical grand_database_6040_units.csv methodology, and reconcile which of the previously-flagged 4 units survive under the correct definitions.

title: suite_01_single_raster_panels.ipynb

title: suite_03_tfr_lfp_heatmap2d.ipynb

title: suite_04_tfr_lfp_area_layer_band_power_corr.ipynb

title: suite_05_tfr_lfp_area_layer_imaginary_complex_corr.ipynb

title: Brainstorm: LFP TFR Phase/Complex Coefficient Preprocessing and Interactive Plotting Suite
description: Pre-process and save both real Re(freq, time) and imaginary Im(freq, time) components of the Morlet wavelet coefficients to support phase-locking (PLV), imaginary complex correlation (Suite 05), and phase coherence. Integrate interactive ipywidgets (for smoothing scale and band selection) and standardized timing overlays across all 10 notebooks.

title: Dual-engine (Parametric & Nonparametric) Significance Testing utility
description: Implement a unified statistical comparison helper in jnwb/statistics.py that runs both parametric (t-test/ANOVA) and nonparametric (Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney) tests on multi-trial averaged data (PSTHs, LFP power, correlations) and applies Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across time/frequency bins to control false positives.

title: Hierarchy-Wide Multi-Band Power Correlation Matrix Heatmaps
description: Generate pairwise power correlation heatmaps across the V1-to-PFC hierarchy for four distinct bands (Theta 2-8Hz, Alpha 8-14Hz, Beta 15-30Hz, Gamma 32-80Hz) to compare stimulus vs omission periods, with statistical significance overlays corrected for multiple comparisons.

title: LFP Spectral Power Omission Dampening Traces
description: Plot hierarchy-wide LFP power traces relative to baseline for visual stimulation, delay, and omission epochs across V1, V2, MT, TEO, V3a, FST, FEF, and PFC, with shaded SEM and corrected statistical significance bands.

title: Single-Unit Omission-Ramping vs Stimulus-Driven Profile Classification
description: Classify single-neuron spiking patterns into stimulus-excited, stimulus-inhibited, and omission-ramping profiles using Wilcoxon and Mann-Whitney significance criteria relative to pre-stimulus and pre-omission baselines (q < 0.05 FDR corrected).

title: Hierarchy-Wide Multi-Unit Activity (MUA) Sequence Response Profile
description: Epoch and plot MUA timecourses across V1, V3a, MT, FEF, and PFC over the entire visual stimulation sequence (4 stimulus presentations + delays + omission window) to test if omission selectively spares lower-order sensory MUA while producing weak, time-locked prediction-error spikes in higher-order FEF/PFC, validated with FDR-corrected Wilcoxon and t-tests.

title: Gamma-Beta Dissociation and R-Squared Change Matrices
description: Calculate the R-squared correlation difference (Stimulus vs Omission window) across visual areas to quantify gamma-beta spectral dissociation, verifying if FEF/PFC show the lowest correlation change across states, backed by bootstrapped confidence intervals and multiple comparison corrections.
